# NuStack Marketing Engine

> Patient Acquisition Platform for multi-location men's health clinics

NuStack Marketing Engine is a proprietary PPC and marketing automation SaaS platform that auto-generates location landing pages, captures leads with 60-second SMS response, runs full 7-day nurture sequences, automates Google Business Profile management, and provides closed-loop attribution from ad spend to booked appointment to clinic revenue.

## Core Features
- Location landing page factory (auto-generated, A/B tested, GCLID-captured)
- 60-second SMS lead response via Twilio + Inngest
- 7-day automated nurture sequence (SMS + email)
- Google Business Profile automation (daily sync, AI review responses, weekly posts)
- Multi-platform campaign factory (Google Ads + Meta Ads, feature-flagged)
- Closed-loop attribution dashboard (lead → booked → showed → revenue)
- Budget pacing engine (every 4 hours)
- HIPAA-compliant architecture (server-side CAPI only, no pixels on health pages)

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Supabase (PostgreSQL + RLS)
- Clerk (multi-role auth)
- Twilio (SMS)
- Resend (email)
- Inngest (background jobs)
- Claude claude-sonnet-4-6 (ad copy, review responses, insights)
- PostHog (A/B testing)
- Recharts (analytics)

## Compliance
- No Meta Pixel or Google Tag on health-context pages
- All conversions via server-side CAPI (offline conversion queue)
- No PHI sent to Google or Meta APIs
- GCLID cookie flow for attribution without PII exposure
- All ad copy passes compliance checker before API submission

## Dashboard
- /dashboard — overview
- /dashboard/locations — location management
- /dashboard/leads — lead pipeline
- /dashboard/analytics — attribution reporting
- /dashboard/campaigns — campaign performance
- /dashboard/reviews — GBP review queue
- /dashboard/reports — client-facing reports
- /dashboard/settings — integrations
